name: Weightfield
description: One bar per cell, thickening from a hairline to a block across the sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: @calc(48 - 28 * @x / @X)%; height: @calc(4 + 56 * @x / @X)%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
